prompt:
A sprite sheet of 15 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 5 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) mine cart full of ore on rails; 2) empty mine cart; 3) short straight rail track piece; 4) pile of glowing blue ore crystals; 5) pile of copper ore; 6) timber support frame; 7) blacksmith anvil on a stump; 8) stone forge furnace (cold); 9) rack of pickaxes and shovels; 10) hanging lantern on a hook post (unlit); 11) wooden crate of tools; 12) dwarf-sized stone oath monument with carved runes; 13) bellows; 14) barrel of coal; 15) iron lift cage frame.
Scale: trees are about 60-70 art pixels tall, small items about 16-24 art pixels; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a single transparent-background sprite sheet of EXACTLY 15 distinct isolated props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG. Layout is 3 columns by 5 rows, reading left to right across each row, then downward. Keep generous transparent margins around every object; no touching, overlapping, cropping, ground, shadows, typography, labels or numbers. Contents by row: row 1: (1) mine cart full of ore on a tiny segment of rails, (2) empty mine cart, (3) short straight rail track piece. Row 2: (4) pile of blue ore crystals, blue-colored but NOT luminous or emitting light, (5) pile of copper ore, (6) freestanding timber support frame. Row 3: (7) blacksmith anvil on stump, (8) cold stone forge furnace with no fire, (9) rack of pickaxes and shovels. Row 4: (10) hanging UNLIT lantern on a hook post, (11) wooden crate of tools, (12) short dwarf-sized stone oath monument bearing abstract carved rune-like marks (no readable text). Row 5: (13) bellows, (14) barrel of coal, (15) iron lift cage frame. Each object seen from consistent classic three-quarter top-down RPG viewpoint, visible upper surface and front face, upright with feet/base at bottom. Cohesive premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel-art game assets, hand-placed pixel clusters, clear silhouettes, rich earthy worn materials, 4-6 discrete shades per material, purple/reddish saturated shadows and warm yellowish highlights. Uniform strict crisp square pixel grid throughout the entire image, each art pixel approximately 8 by 8 output image pixels; sharp pixel edges with NO anti-aliasing, blur, soft brushes, photographic textures, noise, or dithering checkerboards. Neutral soft even upper-left ambient illumination, clean base colors only, no cast shadows, nighttime lighting, glow, lamp light, light pools or vignette. Fully transparent alpha background.
